hero.title: ExtraPawn — The Chess Gym for Serious Players
hero.subtitle: A complete preparation ecosystem for tournament players (1500+)

what.title: What is it?
what.text: **ExtraPawn** is a professional training environment where every module flows logically into the next. Not just a place for puzzles, but a full-fledged gym designed to bridge the gap between amateur play and Grandmaster-level preparation.

forWho.title: For Whom?
forWho.text: For those stuck on a plateau who want real progress. ExtraPawn doesn't teach the basic rules — it digitizes your weaknesses and eliminates them systematically.

uniqueness.title: What makes us unique?
uniqueness.text: The market is flooded with disconnected tools. ExtraPawn combines everything into a **single closed-loop training cycle**: Build your repertoire → Test it in sparring → Hone the realization → Analyze weaknesses → Fix. All modules sync progress in one unified dashboard.

puzzlePlay.title: PUZZLE PLAY — Tactics & Endgames
puzzlePlay.text:
Four highly specialized training modes for focused learning. All tasks are divided into three difficulties: **Novice, Pro, and Master**. An intelligent **Coach Sidebar** on the right provides visual hints, prevents blunders, and can be set to permanent mode for beginners.

• **Theoretical Endgames**: Textbook endgame positions. Memorize and internalize the exact winning or defensive paths.
• **FinishHim**: Convert a winning advantage against the human-like Maia (2200 Elo) engine across 19 popular practical themes.
• **Practical Endgames**: 20 themes classified from real practical games. Perfect your realization technique under realistic conditions.
• **Tactics**: The most popular Lichess tactics, categorized into 20 distinct motifs.

taskToday.title: TASK TODAY — Personalized Daily Trainer
taskToday.text:
The ultimate tool for daily training. Training plans are generated in three difficulties (Novice, Pro, Master) based on three strategies:

• 💡 **Discovery**: Learn new themes and fill gaps in your knowledge.
• 🔥 **Hardcore**: Target and attack your biggest weaknesses (where you get beaten most often).
• ⚡ **Warmup**: Reinforce your knowledge by sharpening your strongest themes.

Solve under pressure with a timer and progress tracker. At the end, you get a detailed performance report. All results are saved on the backend and shape future plans.

sparring.title: SPARRING — Play Practice & Analysis
sparring.text:
Play free games starting from the initial position or any custom setup, with or without tablebase support and graphical hints.

• **Coach Sidebar**: Features strategic information and an Analysis tab on the right.
• **Opening Explorer**: Stats-based opening book on the left, created from Lichess games of 2000+ Elo users, using color-coded hints.
• **Wikibooks Integration**: Access extensive theoretical guides and information on any played opening.
• **AI Coach**: Under active development and will soon be upgraded with a personal AI sparring coach.

userCabinet.title: USER CABINET — Your Chess DNA
userCabinet.text: The visual command center for displaying your training results. Analyze your chess development across all themes, identify your strengths and weaknesses precisely, and track your performance history.
